name: Melorheostosis with Osteopoikilosis

criteria.description: Characteristic 'dripping candle wax' hyperostosis on radiographs
Multiple small, round or ovoid sclerotic bone lesions consistent with osteopoikilosis on imaging
Progressive limb deformities and joint contractures associated with melorheostosis
Histological confirmation showing dense, irregular cortical bone formation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic radiologic findings of both melorheostosis and osteopoikilosis with compatible clinical features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily radiological supported by clinical presentation; genetic testing may assist but is not definitive.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Complete duplication of the distal phalanges of the hand

imaging: Radiographs showing segmental cortical hyperostosis with 'dripping candle wax' appearance
Multiple small, round or ovoid sclerotic lesions consistent with osteopoikilosis
CT and MRI may show cortical thickening and soft tissue involvement
other: Histopathology reveals dense, irregular cortical bone formation with fibrosis

distinguishingFeatures: Isolated segmental hyperostosis without multiple sclerotic bone islands
Presence of multiple sclerotic bone islands without cortical hyperostosis
Linear striations of increased bone density rather than segmental hyperostosis

redFlags: Severe joint contractures causing functional impairment
references: Léri A, Joanny J. Sur une affection non décrite des os: hyperostose en coulée de cire fondue. Bull Mem Soc Med Hop Paris. 1922.
Hellemans J, et al. Somatic mutations in MAP2K1 cause melorheostosis. Nat Genet. 2018.
